text:
maya: quick heads-up — eng-platform is proposing a small header + SDK field to opt into route hints for quota/routing. want devex + SDK owners to weigh in. :eyes:

sandeep: summary: add `x-rw-route-hint: <policy>:<preference>` (e.g. `cost:low`, `latency:fast`, `region:us-east-1`). its purely a hint for smart routing and quota attribution, not a hard pin. will be used by dedicated/private routing layers and the console for per-route quota views.

nick: curious about quota semantics — if user sets `cost:low` do we charge differently or just prefer cheaper model variants?

sandeep: prefer cheaper variants and route to cheaper pools first. billing stays on existing units; the console will show "route-attributed" token counts for visibility. no separate pricing tier in this phase.

lina: UX concern: console should make it obvious that route-hint is a suggestion. maybe a tooltip + small banner during rollout. also want telemetry flags so we can A/B observe quality/regressions.

maya: SDK impact: surface param `route_hint` in language client constructors and per-call options. python example:```py
from redwood import Client
c = Client(api_key=..., route_hint="cost:low")
resp = c.generate("Hello", route_hint="latency:fast")
```

nick: minimal SDK change is fine. need to decide header encoding (single header vs structured). prefer single header string for backwards compatibility.

sandeep: single header it is. we also want a short telemetry tag `x-rw-route-tag` emitted to TT to help correlate in traces. that one will be sampling-only.

maya: docs & changelog: devex will add examples and call out server-side fallbacks. can we get a short compatibility contract for older SDKs? e.g., if SDK doesn't send header we treat as `default` route.

sandeep: yes — default behaviour is unchanged. older SDKs keep working; console will show a growing portion of "unattributed" tokens until SDKs upgrade.

lina: rollout plan for console: step 1 show route-hint breakdown as opt-in toggle for beta orgs. step 2 add banners and prompts in onboarding. step 3 make it visible by default after 4 weeks if no issues.

nick: tests: eng will add e2e that asserts `x-rw-route-hint` wins in routing decision when present, and a fallback test. also add quota attribution tests for dedicated tenants.

maya: action items: (1) SDKs — add `route_hint` param + header encoding (assignments: python @maya, ts @sandeep?); (2) eng — telemetry tag + routing acceptance tests (assign @nick); (3) product/devex — console UX beta toggle + docs (assign @lina & @maya).

deploy-bot: scheduled a canary deploy of routing service at 2028-07-15T02:30Z — will run traffic with `route_hint` sampling enabled.

maya: @sandeep can you post the exact header spec in this thread so SDK PRs match? also ping when canary starts so we can watch dash metrics. :thumbsup:

sandeep: will post the spec in the next comment and open the platform RFC.

nick: quick note on telemetry: please include a non-identifying enum in traces, not raw header, to avoid sensitive strings leaking.

sandeep: ack. we'll map hints to small ints in traces.

maya: thanks all — I'll spin up the Python PR and link here.
